canonicalRequirements.title: Attendance and Login Requirements
canonicalRequirements.description: Students must log into the course during the first two weeks of the semester and must maintain an overall login attendance of at least 85 percent of the modules. Failure to comply may result in administrative withdrawal from the course.

canonicalRequirements.title: Discussion Participation
canonicalRequirements.description: Students are required to participate in weekly class discussions. Each initial discussion post must meet a minimum word count of 500 words and include cited references. Additionally, students must respond to at least two classmates' postings.

canonicalRequirements.title: Assignment Deadlines and Late Work Policy
canonicalRequirements.description: Weekly assignments are due on Sunday by 11:59 PM EDT. No late work will be accepted, and no make-up dates will be given, without prior communication and approval for an extension from the instructor.

canonicalRequirements.title: APA Formatting Requirement
canonicalRequirements.description: Written references in APA format are required for every document prepared and submitted by students in this course.

canonicalRequirements.title: Course Communication Protocol
canonicalRequirements.description: Students must use D2L course mail to communicate regarding academic matters, rather than using external email systems.

canonicalRequirements.title: Academic Integrity and Originality
canonicalRequirements.description: Plagiarism, cheating, and unapproved external help are strictly forbidden. Students must submit original work created exclusively for this course and must properly cite all external ideas or sources.

canonicalRequirements.title: Religious Observance Notification
canonicalRequirements.description: Students needing to be absent for religious observances must inform their instructor at least two weeks before the holiday to arrange accommodations for missed materials or assignments.
